text:
Give Mira a heads-up before you leave, not a surprise. At two, big feelings still outpace the words to handle them, so an abrupt exit tips her over.

A couple of things that help:

- A five- and two-minute warning ("two more slides, then we go").
- A small ritual to close it out — wave bye to the swings, count the steps to the gate, or pick one leaf to take home.

The meltdowns usually ease as she gets better at transitions. In the meantime, staying calm and matter-of-fact when she melts down — no negotiating, no long explanations — helps her learn that leaving is just what happens next.
